# N37 Governance Index — node plan/audit state (N1–N37, +N2.5)

**Generated**: 2026-08-16, by N37 subagent B (D6/AA5) — generated by scripted
extraction (Git Bash grep/sed) over every node file in `docs/nodes/`; no node
file was edited to produce this index.
**Scope**: every node artifact set that exists as files: N1–N37 plus N2.5
(38 rows). `N4a`/`N4b` are referenced by master plan changelog v1.1.0 but no
such files exist (see Gaps).
**Extraction rules**: plan status = first `**Status**:` line of `N{k}-PLAN.md`
(verbatim, trimmed). Audit verdict = the LAST anchored verdict line
(`^**VERDICT`, `^#+ VERDICT`, or `— VERDICT:` heading forms) of the audit
file — i.e. the final round verdict, not an earlier round or narrative
reference to a prior round.
